name: SFV OG Cartridge | 1g
description:
Platinum Vape SFV OG is an Indica strain. SFV OG cartridges 1g is THC dominant cannabis derived distillate. PV cartridges are compatible with 510 thread batteries.

Flavor Profile: Pine, Earthy, Lemon

Effects: Happy, Relaxed, Uplifted, Euphoric, Focused

Platinum Vape only uses the best ingredients nature has to offer in each cartridge, by extracting top-quality cannabis oil from a pesticide-free, high-potency harvest of the finest cannabis flowers.
